content:
Although there are reports that Apple is debating whether the built-in camera on its upcoming glasses product should allow users to take photos and videos, DuckDuckGo has gone a step further...

The privacy-first search engine company is selling a pair of sunglasses called the DuckDuckGo Paso Robles, with the tagline "normal-looking, normal-acting sunglasses".

The company touts benefits including infinite battery life, guaranteed zero notifications, and "seamless offline mode".

While the company is clearly promoting its privacy ethos with tongue firmly in cheek, the sunglasses actually exist and can be purchased. That's quite a clever PR move.
